senses.gloss:
भेष् {c1c} U. (भेषति-ते) To fear,
dread, be afraid.

भेषज a. [भेषं रोगभयं जयति जि-ड
Tv.] Making well or healthy,
curative.
--जं
1 A medicine,
medicament, or drug; नरानंब त्रातुं त्वमिह
परमं भेषजमसि G. L. 15; अतिवीर्यवतीव
भेषजे बहुरल्पीयसि दृश्यते गुणः
Ki. 2. 4.
--2 A remedy or cure in general.
--3 A kind of fennel.
--4 Any spell
against diseases.
--5 Water (Ved.).
--Comp.
--अ (आ) गारः, --रं an
apothecary's shop.
--अंगं anything taken
after medicine.

भेषज्य a. Curative, having
healing properties.
